home.title: Welcome to Wishi
home.description: Create and share wishlists with your family members.

auth.signInDescription: Enter your credentials to access your family space
auth.signUpDescription: Join Wishi to create and share family wishlists

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Here is what is happening on Wishi.

wishlist.name: Wishlist Name
wishlist.empty: You haven't created any wishlists yet.
wishlist.noItems: No items in this wishlist yet.
wishlist.shareHelp: Anyone with the link can view this list. An account is required to reserve gifts.
wishlist.surprise: Reservations stay hidden to preserve the surprise.
wishlist.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
wishlist.publicShareHelp: This list is public. Sign in to reserve. Reservations stay hidden from the owner.

family.title: Family Space
family.noFamily: You haven't joined any family yet.
family.invitationFor: Join {name}. This personal invitation expires after 7 days.
family.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? Its link will no longer allow joining the family.
family.invitationSaved: Invitation saved. Find its link in pending invitations.
family.invitationReplacement: A new link for the same email replaces its previous invitation.
family.invitationShareHelp: Send this link only to the invited person. They must use the invitation email address.
family.confirmRenew: Create a new link valid for seven days? The previous link will stop working.
family.pendingHelp: {count} invitations await a reply. Share the link yourself: invitation emails are not sent automatically.

events.title: Events
events.name: Event Name
events.noWishlists: No accessible wishlists for this event.
events.confirmDelete: Delete this event? Gift wishlists will be kept.

errors.invalidFields: Check the fields: a name, a non-negative price and an http or https link.
errors.registrationInvalid: Check your name, email and password length (at least 12 characters).
errors.emailInUse: This email is already in use.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidInvitation: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.wrongEmail: Sign in using the email address this invitation was sent to.
errors.invalidPhoto: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP photo up to 5 MB.
errors.emailUnavailable: Email recovery is not available yet. Please contact the person who manages Wishi.
errors.invalidResetLink: This link has expired or has already been used.
errors.alreadyMember: This person already belongs to the family.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.signupLimited: Too many registration attempts. Try again in an hour.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your previous one.
errors.transferFirst: Transfer family ownership before leaving or removing its owner.
errors.lastAdmin: The family must keep at least one administrator.

reservations.title: My reserved gifts
reservations.intro: Find the gifts you plan to give. These reservations stay hidden from recipients.
reservations.empty: You have not reserved a gift yet.
reservations.accessChanged: Access to this list has changed. You can still cancel your reservation.

recovery.title: Forgot password
recovery.intro: Enter your email to receive a recovery link.
recovery.sent: If an account matches this email, a recovery link has been sent. It is valid for 30 minutes.
recovery.resetSuccess: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

giftSearch.title: Find gifts
giftSearch.name: Name
giftSearch.count: {count, plural, =0 {No gifts shown} =1 {1 gift shown} other {# gifts shown}}
giftSearch.unpriced: {count, plural, =1 {1 gift without a listed price} other {# gifts without a listed price}}
giftSearch.currencies: Amounts are grouped by currency without conversion.
giftSearch.surpriseHelp: Reservations stay hidden to preserve your surprise.

accountSecurity.title: Change my password
accountSecurity.hint: Your current password is required. This change signs out all your devices and cancels previous recovery links.

familyManagement.title: Manage members
familyManagement.ownerMustTransfer: To leave this family, first transfer ownership to another member.
familyManagement.confirmLeave: Leave this family? You will lose access to its events and family lists unless you share another family.
familyManagement.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from this family? Their lists will be kept and detached from this family’s events.
familyManagement.confirmPromote: Make {name} an administrator of this family?
familyManagement.confirmTransfer: Transfer ownership to {name}? You will become a member and this person will become an administrator.

listLifecycle.confirmTrash: Move this list to trash? Gifts and reservations will be kept and sharing will be disabled. You can restore it later.
listLifecycle.archiveHelp: Archived lists remain visible to their owner. Sharing and editing are suspended. Restoring makes them private.
listLifecycle.trashHelp: Trashed lists retain gifts and reservations without automatic deletion. Restoring makes them private and cancels old sharing links.
listLifecycle.copyHelp: The copy will be private, without an event or reservations. Its photos will be independent of the original list.

giftTrash.title: Removed gifts ({count})
giftTrash.help: These gifts are hidden from visitors. Their photos and reservations are kept without automatic deletion.
giftTrash.confirm: Remove this gift? Its photo and reservation will be kept. You can restore it in the Removed gifts section.

sharing.title: Share
sharing.manualCopy: Automatic copying failed. Select the link below to copy it.
sharing.qrAlt: QR code for the sharing link
sharing.scan: Scan this code to open the link.

onboarding.title: Getting started with Wishi
onboarding.intro: Create your first wishlist and connect with your family.
onboarding.familyHelp: Create your family here, or open an invitation link from a relative to join.
onboarding.listHelp: Add gift ideas, with an optional photo and price.
onboarding.shareHelp: Choose who can view your list. You will not see who reserves your gifts.

productImport.help: Paste an HTTPS product link. Existing fields are kept. Some websites block previews; you can always fill in the gift yourself.
productImport.failed: Information unavailable. Fill in the fields manually or retry in a few seconds.
productImport.review: Suggested information: check the name, price and photo before saving. Prices can change.
